mapper.insert: ALTER TABLE maven2_component ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS base_version VARCHAR NULL; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_maven2_component_base_version ON maven2_component (base_version);
mapper.select: SELECT namespace as "group", name, base_version, COUNT(*) AS count FROM maven2_component WHERE repository_id = #{repositoryId} AND base_version LIKE '%-SNAPSHOT' AND deleted_on IS NULL GROUP BY namespace, name, base_version HAVING COUNT(*) > #{minimumRetained};

SELECT DISTINCT(snapshots.component_id) FROM maven2_component snapshots, maven2_component releases WHERE snapshots.repository_id = #{repositoryId} AND snapshots.name = releases.name AND snapshots.namespace = releases.namespace AND snapshots.base_version LIKE '%-SNAPSHOT' AND snapshots.last_updated <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - CAST(#{gracePeriod} AS INT) * INTERVAL '1' DAY) AND releases.base_version = REPLACE(snapshots.base_version, '-SNAPSHOT', '')
AND snapshots.deleted_on IS NULL AND releases.deleted_on IS NULL ;
